items.title: 'Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo, Winter 2027 Premiere
items.summary: Production company Asmik Ace opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Juntarou Aoki and Shin Moriyama's Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara (Getting Shots on Frying Pan) manga on Thursday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a teaser promotional video. Produced by J.C.Staff, the anime is scheduled to premiere on Nippon TV, Yomiuri TV, BS Nippon TV, and AT-X in January 2027. Voice actors Shuu Uchida (Yarinaoshi Reijou wa Ryuutei Heika wo Kouryakuchuu) and Masaaki Mizunaka (Nyaight of the Living Cat) are voicing the beautiful girl and male versions of Juntarou Aoki, respectively. Staff Director: Masahiro Hiraoka (Kabushikigaisha Magi-Lumière) Series Composition, Script: Susumu Yamakawa (Maiko-san Chi no Makanai-san) Character Design, Chief Animation Director: Natsuki Ooyama (Danjo no Yuujou wa Seiritsu suru? (Iya, Shinai!!)) Music: Yoshihide Ootomo (Inu-Ou) Sound Director: Yoshikazu Iwanami (Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo) Aoki began serializing the slice of life manga, with illustrations by Moriyama, on Comic Newtype website in May 2021. Kadokawa published the fifth volume in October 2024. A spin-off series titled Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara Transit featuring Hirota Takahara, began serializing on March 20. Teaser PV Official site: https://nabetama.asmik-ace.co.jp/ Source: Comic Natalie

items.text:
Asmik Ace a dévoilé le site officiel de l’adaptation télévisée du manga *Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara*. La série, produite par J.C.Staff, sera diffusée sur Nippon TV, Yomiuri TV, BS Nippon TV et AT‑X en janvier 2027. Le casting principal comprend Shuu Uchida et Masaaki Mizunaka dans les rôles de la fille et du garçon Juntarou Aoki. Le staff réunit Masahiro Hiraoka à la direction, Susumu Yamakawa pour la composition du scénario, Natsuki Ooyama comme character designer et chief animation director, et Yoshihide Ootomo pour la musique.

items.title: Roundtable: Bartosz Sztybor on Potential Edgerunners Season 3, Retelling David and Lucy's Relationship, and Roman's Personal Inspirations
items.summary: Interview Roundtable: Bartosz Sztybor on Potential Edgerunners Season 3, Retelling David and Lucy’s Relationship, and Roman’s Personal Inspirations Written by Jorge Manuel Sanchez Moreno Cardenas November 12, 2026 Following the CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 2 panel at Lucca Comics & Games, we sat down with showrunner Bartosz Sztybor to talk even deeper about Season 2 and its connection to other elements of the franchise. We talked about the creation process with Studio TRIGGER, how he deals with Cyberpunk ‘s lore, and his insight into Roman, D, Capri, and other characters. Bartosz, who also writes the manga Cyberpunk: Edgerunners MADNESS with illustrator Asano, also commented on the connections between the different Cyberpunk media. Just as in our previous interview about Season 1 , we had a great time talking with Sztybor about the reasoning behind his writing decisions. With his particular humor, he is always open to sharing his thoughts—even at the risk of spoilers. Portions of this roundtable have been edited for clarity. Beware of CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 1 and 2 plot spoilers below. IGN: Given what you were talking about on the panel today, what are your thoughts right now on a potential Season 3? items.text:
Dans une table‑ronde publiée par Anime Corner, le showrunner Bartosz Sztybor a évoqué la possibilité d’une troisième saison de *Cyberpunk: Edgerunners*. Il a rappelé qu’il pensait déjà à de futures saisons dès l’écriture de la première, et qu’il souhaite explorer davantage les relations entre les personnages, notamment David et Lucy, ainsi que ses propres inspirations.
